mapper.select: SELECT s.sku_id AS skuId, s.product_id AS productId, p.product_name AS productName, ( SELECT pi.image_path FROM product_image pi WHERE pi.product_id = p.product_id AND pi.image_type = 'THUMB' ORDER BY pi.sort_order ASC, pi.image_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS thumbPath, GROUP_CONCAT( CONCAT(po.option_name, ': ', pov.option_value) ORDER BY pov.sort_order SEPARATOR ' / ' ) AS optionSummary FROM sku s JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN option_value_sku ovs ON s.sku_id = ovs.sku_id LEFT JOIN product_option_value pov ON ovs.option_value_id = pov.option_value_id LEFT JOIN product_option po ON pov.option_id = po.option_id WHERE s.sku_id = #{skuId} GROUP BY s.sku_id, s.product_id, p.product_name
